scope: Read-only parse and comparison of the actual Chrome UI-downloaded 16-case archive with the retained numerical QA data. No solver rerun, production modification, WebGL image acceptance or graphics-performance measurement.

browserDownload.note: 3.12 deployed browser verification: default parameters, constant-pressure external supply, 6 m/s crosswind, healthy front-right nozzle.

conditions.defaultParameterEvidence: The retained fixture source declares only kind=attitude and params.supplyMode=bench. normalizeResearchRequest expands DEFAULT_PARAMS, with bench explicitly overriding the scientific finite-supply default. Both source definitions and hashes were verified without executing code.

comparisonMethod.pairing: Exact declared roll/height grid key; unique complete requests must match exactly before numeric comparison.
comparisonMethod.requestsAndIdentities: Exact equality; no tolerance used for parameter or request equality.

numericComparison.purpose: Roundoff comparison bounds only; none of the physical success/contact thresholds is changed.

comparisonMethod.otherValues: All categorical, boolean and null leaves require exact matching, and object keys/list lengths must match.
metadataExcluded: Browser archive note and export time

floatingPointInterpretation.explanation: The largest curve difference occurs for near-zero tilt computed as acos(clamp(bodyUpY,-1,1)) in experiment-worker.js. Inverting these reported angles gives a cosine difference of approximately 2.22e-16. The near-zero acos mapping amplifies roundoff into about 5.00e-7 degrees. This is consistent with cross-runtime double-precision rounding, not a changed physical condition; the physical success tilt threshold remains 2 degrees. This interpretation is inferred from the saved values and source, without re-executing the solver.

executionAttempt.wallClockMeaning: Difference of saved browser attempt timestamps for this batch; not GPU/FPS or route performance.
executionAttempt.reason: 全部方案已返回实际求解结果

nullValueSemantics.explanation: All 16 actual reports and returned grid cases are present. Null scientific fields remain intentional: e.g. undefined airborne road beta/slip, events that never occurred, inapplicable stopping/landing fields, and no recovery time for the contact case. Null sourceConfiguration means no historical configuration origin after default reset. These are not missing Worker results.

heightWarningSemantics.warningDefinition: During any part of the full 12 s, absolute COM-height error from the starting height exceeds 0.75 m continuously for at least 0.25 s. The first confirmation time is retained even if the error subsequently recovers.
heightWarningSemantics.finalRecoveryDefinition: The last continuous segment through the end must satisfy tilt/roll/pitch <2 degrees, angular speed <0.15 rad/s, abs(vertical speed)<0.4 m/s and abs(starting-height error)<0.75 m for at least 0.5 s, with no tire or rigid-body contact anywhere in the run.

limits: This compares saved full 120 Hz summary statistics and every saved 10 Hz sample. The unsaved individual 120 Hz state sequence is not present and was not reconstructed.
Browser-generated timestamps and user-facing download provenance are retained; this parse does not independently measure browser CPU or graphics frame time.
Floating-point differences mean the browser and Node numeric reports are not asserted to be bit-for-bit identical.
No change was made to production code, tests, source JSON archives, or the original browser download.
provenancePathNote: Public paths name the preserved repository files. Original comparison was produced read-only from the actual browser download; only these three source-path labels were made portable.
